name: SUNO 1:1:1 Tincture – 200MG
description: Crafted with 100% refined hemp seed oil and balanced with 200mg THC, 200mg CBD, and 200mg THCA per 30mL bottle. Each 1mL serving provides approximately 6.66mg of each cannabinoid per 1mL serving. Metered droppers ensure accurate dosing every time. Vegan. Nut-free. Free of dyes, sugar, and gluten. Clinically Relevant Cannabis. Clinically Relevant Results.
